Description: Design a calm modern bedroom. Use a low-profile bed centered on the main wall, two matching nightstands, a wardrobe against a side wall, and a reading chair with a floor lamp in a free corner. Keep the major furniture visually consistent in a clean, low-ornament modern style. Preserve a clear entrance route and usable space in front of the wardrobe.
CriticGoal: modern bedroom style cohesion, bedside symmetry, wardrobe access, and circulation

Description: Design an inviting Asian-inspired living room. Place a sofa facing a low media console with a television on top, a coffee table centered between them, two accent chairs facing the table, and a display cabinet against a wall. Use major furniture with a coherent East Asian design language such as warm wood, restrained joinery, or regional silhouettes. Keep a clear path from the entrance through the seating area.
CriticGoal: Asian living-room style cohesion, media alignment, conversational seating, and circulation

Description: Design a polished contemporary home office. Place one desk against a wall with an office chair facing it and a monitor on the desk, two guest chairs opposite the desk, a bookshelf on an adjacent wall, and a small storage cabinet. Use a coherent contemporary furniture language with refined current-era materials and silhouettes. Keep the desk front and the central aisle accessible.
CriticGoal: contemporary office style cohesion, desk-chair-monitor relation, guest seating, and access

Description: Design an industrial dining room. Center one rectangular dining table, arrange six dining chairs with three evenly spaced on each long side and none on the short sides, and place a sideboard against a wall. Use major furniture with an industrial character such as exposed metal structure, robust wood, and factory-derived utility. Keep circulation clear around every chair and the sideboard.
CriticGoal: industrial dining style cohesion, exact long-side seating distribution, sideboard access, and circulation

Description: Design an elegant traditional bedroom. Center a bed on the main wall, place one matching nightstand and table lamp on each side, position a dresser on the opposite wall facing the bed, and place a wardrobe against a side wall. Use a coherent traditional furniture language with formal proportions and restrained carved or molded details. Keep both bed sides and all storage fronts usable.
CriticGoal: traditional bedroom style cohesion, bed-nightstand-lamp relations, storage access, and circulation

Description: Design a warm midcentury-modern living room. Place a sofa against a wall facing a television on a low TV stand, center a coffee table between them, add two lounge chairs facing the sofa, and place a bookcase against an adjacent wall. Use major furniture with coherent midcentury cues such as tapered legs, low profiles, and organic curves. Keep open circulation around the seating group.
CriticGoal: midcentury living-room style cohesion, media alignment, seating relation, and circulation
